definitions.explanation: Not happening often, on rare occasions.

examples.japanese: {稀|まれ}に{失敗|しっぱい}することもある。

examples.english: I can only rarely meet them.

examples.japanese: こういう{天気|てんき}は{稀|まれ}に{見|み}る{程度|ていど}だ。
examples.english: This kind of weather is rarely seen.

notes:
{稀|まれ}に means rarely or seldom.

RELATED FORMS:
- {稀|まれ}: rare (base form, literary)
- {稀|まれ}な: rare (na-adjective)
- {稀|まれ}に: rarely (adverb)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {稀|まれ}に{見|み}る: rarely seen, exceptional
- {稀|まれ}にしか〜ない: only rarely
- {稀|まれ}に{起|お}こる: to rarely occur

SIMILAR WORDS:
- めったに〜ない: seldom, rarely (more common)
- たまに: occasionally, sometimes
- あまり〜ない: not often

REGISTER:
{稀|まれ}に is slightly more literary/formal than めったに〜ない.
